plate_comment: Twin of CM848 0xe3a4 (verified stage 9b): ORs the five alpha condition results (enable bits 0x400 / 0x800 / 0x1000 / 0x2000 / 0x8000 of the feature word) and ramps the alpha base (_APAPBA) toward 0x4000 with two rates around a threshold; 0 when no condition is set. (was timingProtectionFlagsOrchestrator)

Twin of CM848 0xe518 (verified stage 9b): the alpha source selector: the LSG / AFC alpha timeouts, the call of calculateAlphaBase and the alpha state / blend factor outputs. (was vp44RpmBasedFaultDetector)
Twin of CM848 0xe164 (verified stage 9b): the alpha fuel rate condition (_APFLRTAP, enable bit 0x1000). (was cm550_FUN_0000c404)
Twin of CM848 0xe248 (verified stage 9b): the alpha low speed governor condition (_APLSAP, enable bit 0x400). (was cm550_FUN_0000c4b2)
Twin of CM848 0xe2cc (verified stage 9b): the alpha air fuel control condition (_APAFSS, enable bit 0x800). (was cm550_fuelModeTransitionCountdownHandler)
Twin of CM848 0xe218 (verified stage 9b): the alpha on-governor condition (_APGVAP, enable bit 0x2000). (was cm550_FUN_0000c496)
Twin of CM848 0xe360 (verified stage 9b): the alpha low ambient air pressure condition (_APAAPRSS, enable bit 0x8000). (was cm550_FUN_0000c556)

Twin of CM848 0x1b3a0 (verified stage 9b): fills the PGN 65251 engine configuration payload buffer (param_1) from the engine configuration words, starting with the idle point speed. (was faultTimerHandler)

Twin of CM848 0x2588c (verified stage 9b): builds EEC1 (the torque mode from the speed control mode and the fuel limit state, then the engine speed) and sends it with cm550_sendCanMessage. (was j1939GetEngineStateCode)
